gloss: exclusive dealer; authorized retailer; specialty shop

definitions.gloss: exclusive dealer; authorized retailer; specialty shop
definitions.explanation: A shop that has exclusive or authorized rights to sell certain brands or products in a particular area.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専売店|せんばいてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しか⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: This product can only be bought at an exclusive dealer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{専売店|せんばいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A brand's exclusive retailer opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{専売店|せんばいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{販路|はんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げている→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: They are expanding their sales channels nationwide through regional exclusive dealers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{専売|せんばい}→専売：21851_senbai⟧ (exclusive sale, monopoly sale) and ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop). Historically, Japan had a government monopoly system ({専売制度|せんばいせいど}) for products like tobacco and salt, with {専売店|せんばいてん} referring to shops licensed to sell those items. Today the term is mainly used for authorized brand retailers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{専売店|せんばいてん} — authorized exclusive dealer
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{専売店|せんばいてん} — regional exclusive dealer
- {専売店|せんばいてん}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ — exclusive dealership agreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直営店|ちょくえいてん}→直営店：20450_chokueiten⟧ — directly operated store (owned by the brand itself)
- ⟦{代理店|だいりてん}→代理店：21690_dairiten⟧ — agent; distributor (sells on behalf of another)
- {特約店|とくやくてん} — authorized dealer; franchise dealer
